paragraphs.zh: 2.1    Vebindungen der Formel (III) sind erhältlich durch basenkatalysierte Umsetzung mit Verbindungen R1-H, wie Alkohole, Thioalkohole, Amide, Amine, Heteroaromaten, Heterocyclen. Solche Reaktionen sind beispielsweise bekannt aus J. C. Chem. Res., Synop. 1994, 174, Tetrahedron Lett. 27, 279 (1986, J. Org. Chem. 55, 6037 (1990), J. Org. Chem. 54, 3757 (1989).
paragraphs.en: 2.1    Compounds of the formula (III) are obtainable by base-catalysed reaction with compounds R1-H, such as alcohols, thio alcohols, amides, amines, heteroaromatics, heterocycles. Such reactions are known for example from J. C. Chem. Res., Synop. 1994, 174, Tetrahedron Lett. 27, 279 (1986, J. Org. Chem. 55, 6037 (1990), J. Org. Chem. 54, 3757 (1989).
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. 'Vebindungen' is printed exactly so, missing the r of 'Verbindungen'; it is transcribed as printed and is a typo in the original, not a reading error. The 1 of R1 is printed as a superscript and is rendered inline here because the transcription is plain text. The opening parenthesis of '(1986,' is never closed in the printed citation string, and the journal names are printed in italic with the volume numbers 1994, 27, 55 and 54 in bold; both are as printed. A small ink smudge sits under the 'm' of 'Amide' on the second printed line; the word is legible and the mark is a scan artifact, not a character. This item is numbered 2.1 in a list that began on the preceding page; the number is printed flush left with the paragraph indented after it.

paragraphs.zh: 2.2    Vebindungen der Formel (III) sind ebenfalls erhältlich durch Umsetzung mit lithiumorganischen Verbindungen der Formel R1-Li. Solche Reaktionen sind beispielsweise bekannt aus Synth. Commun. 18, 1035, (1988), J. Org. Chem. 46, 3132 (1981).
paragraphs.en: 2.2    Compounds of the formula (III) are likewise obtainable by reaction with organolithium compounds of the formula R1-Li. Such reactions are known for example from Synth. Commun. 18, 1035, (1988), J. Org. Chem. 46, 3132 (1981).
paragraphs.notes: 'Vebindungen' is again printed without the r, exactly as in item 2.1. The 1 of R1 is a printed superscript. 'Synth. Commun.' and 'J. Org. Chem.' are printed in italic and the volume numbers 18 and 46 in bold. The comma after '1035' before the year is as printed.

paragraphs.zh: Verbindungen der Formel (III) sind auch gemäß Schema 3 erhältlich durch basenkatalysierte Umsetzung einer  Verbindung der Formel (V), in der Z1 für OH, SH, NH-Alkyl, NH-Aryl oder NH-Heteroaryl steht, mit kommerziell erhältlichen oder gemäß bekannten Methoden herstellbaren Verbindungen der Formel R1-Z2, in der Z2 für eine Abgangsgruppe steht, wie Halogen, Phenoxy und Alkylsulfonyl. Solche Reaktionen sind beispielsweise bekannt aus Synthesis 1980, 573, Tetrahedron Lett. 37, 4065 (1996).
paragraphs.en: Compounds of the formula (III) are also obtainable according to Scheme 3 by base-catalysed reaction of a  compound of the formula (V), in which Z1 is OH, SH, NH-alkyl, NH-aryl or NH-heteroaryl, with compounds of the formula R1-Z2 which are commercially available or preparable by known methods, in which Z2 is a leaving group such as halogen, phenoxy and alkylsulfonyl. Such reactions are known for example from Synthesis 1980, 573, Tetrahedron Lett. 37, 4065 (1996).
paragraphs.notes: Unnumbered paragraph; it is the one the drawing below it belongs to. The superscript 1 on Z1 and R1 and the superscript 2 on Z2 are printed as superscripts and rendered inline here. The double space between 'einer' and 'Verbindung' is as printed. 'Synthesis' and 'Tetrahedron Lett.' are printed in italic and 1980 and 37 in bold.
Caption line standing alone above the drawing. It is the caption of the reaction scheme recorded in drawings[0].

paragraphs.zh: Die  in Schema 4 angegebene Umsetzung einer Verbindung der Formel (Ia) mit einem Halogenierungsreagenz, wie Oxalylchlorid oder Oxalylbromid, führt zu erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen der Formel (Ib), die durch Reaktion, gegebenenfalls unter Basenkatalyse, mit Nukleophilen, wie Alkalimetallcyaniden,
paragraphs.en: The reaction, given in Scheme 4, of a compound of the formula (Ia) with a halogenating reagent such as oxalyl chloride or oxalyl bromide leads to compounds according to the invention of the formula (Ib), which by reaction, optionally under base catalysis, with nucleophiles such as alkali metal cyanides,
paragraphs.notes: Unnumbered paragraph; it runs off the foot of the page unterminated and continues on the next page, which opens with 'Alkalimetallcyanaten, Alkalimetallthiocyanaten, ...'. The double space between 'Die' and 'in' is as printed. The 'I' of (Ia) and (Ib) is a capital I in the sans-serif face of the scan, where it is shaped like a lower-case l; it is read as the roman numeral I used throughout this patent for the general formulae. Scheme 4 itself is not on this page.

between_markers: unnumbered paragraph beginning 'Die  in Schema 4 angegebene Umsetzung'

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st, left of the arrow, labelled (V) beneath it
structures.core: benzene ring drawn as a hexagon with one vertex upper-left, one at the top, one upper-right, one lower-right, one at the bottom and one lower-left; three inner double-bond lines are drawn, giving an aromatic benzene
substituents: C(=O)R at C1, the upper-left ring vertex; the carbonyl carbon carries a double bond to O drawn upward and a single bond to a plain, unnumbered R drawn to the left
R2 at C2, the top ring vertex, the vertex adjacent to C1 on the R2 side
L at C3, the upper-right ring vertex; L in turn carries Z1, drawn as L-Z1 going out to the right
R4 at C4, the lower-right ring vertex
R5 at C5, the bottom ring vertex
R6 at C6, the lower-left ring vertex, the vertex adjacent to C1 on the other side from R2

structures.position_in_drawing: 2nd, right of the arrow, labelled (III) beneath it
structures.core: the same benzene ring, drawn identically as an aromatic hexagon with three inner double-bond lines
substituents: C(=O)R at C1, the upper-left ring vertex; double bond to O drawn upward, single bond to a plain, unnumbered R drawn to the left
R2 at C2, the top ring vertex
L at C3, the upper-right ring vertex; L in turn carries R1, drawn as L-R1 going out to the right
R4 at C4, the lower-right ring vertex
R5 at C5, the bottom ring vertex
R6 at C6, the lower-left ring vertex

arrows.notes: Single horizontal solid arrow with a filled head pointing right. 'R1-Z2' is written above it, with the 1 on R and the 2 on Z printed as superscripts. Nothing at all is written below the arrow: no base, no solvent, no temperature, even though the prose above calls the reaction base-catalysed.

drawings.notes: Scheme 3 as captioned in the text: the only drawing on the page. Two generic Markush structures, starting material (V) on the left and product (III) on the right, separated by one arrow. The transformation drawn is the replacement of Z1 by R1 on the group L at C3; every other position is drawn unchanged. Ring positions are read off the drawing, going round the hexagon from the acyl-bearing vertex in the direction of R2: acyl, R2, L, R4, R5, R6. Note that the ring labels used here are R2, R4, R5 and R6 with no R3 anywhere, and that the group on the carbonyl carbon is a plain unnumbered R; this is the labelling of formulae (III) and (V) and it is not the same labelling as the aryl ring of formula (I) elsewhere in this patent, where the sequence drawn is R2, L-R1, R3, R4, R5. Recorded as drawn, not reconciled. No SMILES is given for either structure: R, R2, R4, R5, R6, L, Z1 and R1 are all undefined variables, so not every atom is determined by the drawing. Presented as the invention's own route, in the sense that it is part of the patent's process disclosure and not a background or prior-art scheme; what it makes is the intermediate of formula (III) rather than a compound of formula (I), and the prose cites earlier literature only as precedent for the reaction type.

discrepancies.what: The prose calls the Scheme 3 reaction base-catalysed, but no base and no conditions of any kind are written on the arrow.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The arrow carries only 'R1-Z2' above it and nothing below it.
discrepancies.text_says: 'basenkatalysierte Umsetzung einer  Verbindung der Formel (V) ... mit ... Verbindungen der Formel R1-Z2' (base-catalysed reaction of a compound of the formula (V) with compounds of the formula R1-Z2).

discrepancies.what: The prose restricts Z1 to five specific meanings, and the drawing shows Z1 only as an unlabelled variable on L.
discrepancies.drawing_says: L-Z1 at C3 of the starting material, with Z1 left as a bare symbol.
discrepancies.text_says: 'in der Z1 für OH, SH, NH-Alkyl, NH-Aryl oder NH-Heteroaryl steht' (in which Z1 is OH, SH, NH-alkyl, NH-aryl or NH-heteroaryl).

discrepancies.what: The ring is labelled R2, R4, R5, R6 with no R3, and the acyl substituent is a plain unnumbered R; this differs from the aryl labelling of formula (I) used elsewhere in the patent. The text on this page does not name the ring substituents, so nothing on this page resolves it.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Going round the ring from the acyl vertex towards R2: acyl (plain R on the carbonyl), R2, L, R4, R5, R6.
discrepancies.text_says: Nothing. The three prose paragraphs on this page mention only R1, Z1 and Z2 and never the ring substituents.
